method: git subtree split, path-prefix rewrite, then unsquashed merge
literalSourceHistory: Original commit IDs and the v0.2.0 tag remain in the archived source repository; rewritten IDs preserve package history at packages/core in this monorepo.

secretAudit.scope: Every blob reachable from the rewritten packages/core history
secretAudit.patterns: private-key markers and common AWS, Google, GitHub, OpenAI, OAuth-client-secret, and Cloudflare-token forms
secretAudit.verification: Re-run by scripts/ws1-release-integrity.ts against every rewritten commit
